description: This file defines the BiometricAuthManager class which manages biometric authentication flows using Android's Biometric API, including checking device capability and prompting for biometric authentication.

classes.name: BiometricAuthManager
classes.description: A class that manages biometric authentication processes, providing methods to check authentication capability and to prompt the user for biometric verification.

methods.name: canAuthenticate
methods.description: Checks whether the device is capable of biometric authentication with strong biometric method.

methods.name: showBiometricPrompt
methods.description: Displays the biometric prompt to the user, handling success, error, and failure callbacks.
